title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép Chính quyền Tỉnh Albay thành lập Văn phòng Kho bạc Tỉnh phụ tại Virac, đảo Catanduanes

title.id: Undang-Undang mengizinkan Pemerintah Provinsi Albay mendirikan Kantor Subkas Daerah di Virac, Pulau Catanduanes
title.ms: Akta membenarkan Kerajaan Wilayah Albay menubuhkan Pejabat Subkhas Wilayah di Virac, Pulau Catanduanes

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00622_1903_html.txt

text.en:
The provincial government of the Province of Albay is hereby authorized to establish permanently
a suboffice of the provincial treasury of the Province of Albay, at Virac, on the Island of Catanduanes, and to
provide, by construction or purchase or renting, a suitable office for such subtreasury.

The public good requiring a speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 6, 1903.
